sources.title: Scicom-intl/semantic-vad-eot-whisper-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The int8 export's scores sit a little lower than the tiny model's (recall at 0.5 is 0.87 vs 0.92 at the pause start), so 0.3 is this model's equivalent of the tiny model's 0.5; at 0.5 it is stricter — one more cut-off avoided, but 10 % of finished turns wait for max_delay. One cut-off turn in 300 separates it from the tiny model at matched fast-path share, which is within noise.
